name: Single Family Rental West
audience: single-family rental owners, operators and investors
headline: Stop building. Start scaling.
summary: Sundae exhibits at Single Family Rental West (IMN), Dec. 7-9, 2026, at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a 10×10 booth. The booth and its creative introduce Sundae Membership to the conference's single-family rental owners, operators and investors: the Sundae Engine (generate more leads, close more deals, maximize profit) and an intro call at sundae.com/membership.
strategy: Before the conference, tell Sundae's network and the conference's audience where to find the booth; at the booth, a simple red backdrop, a handout and a QR code to sundae.com/membership; after it, follow up within 48 hours and book intro calls with experienced operators.
creativeNote: Designed in Sundae's brand: Sundae red, the Sundae wordmark and copy from sundae.com/membership (read Oct. 27, 2026), with no pricing. No photos of people, so the creative fits whoever staffs the booth. QR codes go to sundae.com/membership. The backdrops are 10×10 ft step-and-repeat options with full-size vector PDFs; everything that matters sits above table height. Videos and Reels are silent by design.
sources: Conference facts from informaconnect.com/imn-sfr-west (read Oct. 27, 2026): Single Family Rental West, Dec. 7-9, 2026, Fairmont Scottsdale Princess, Scottsdale, Arizona; 1,800+ SFR decision-makers. Booth (10×10) from the Sundae team; booth number not known yet. Membership copy from sundae.com/membership and the Sundae Membership Agreement (no pricing used). Projections are the dinner model's placeholders, labeled assumptions; they don't apply to a booth.
moves: Confirm the booth number and exhibitor kit
Booth number, setup times and the hotel's shipping instructions from IMN, so the backdrop and handouts arrive on time.
Pick one of the four options; send the full-size PDF to a large-format printer by Friday, Nov. 13.
LinkedIn and Instagram posts (Images 01-04) and a note to marketplace investors attending SFR West.
Bring the handout and QR code
Print 250 booth handouts (Flyer 01); every QR code goes to sundae.com/membership.
Every conversation gets a follow-up and an intro-call link by Wednesday night, Dec. 9.
